openings.claim: Replace dependence on shared closure pressure with independently set hatch-edge registration on removable padded saddles. Sideways load could travel through edge bearing into the rim without tighter left-corner compression.
openings.delta: Retain four-strip upper/lower saddle jaws, six bolts and four pads; change the action to setting edge registration separately from closure pressure. Drill or cut supplied strips only. Join removable pieces with cord and move the complete assembly outside the marked opening for inspection.
openings.prediction: Nearest rival: the same padded saddles with registration disengaged. At identical closure settings, engaged registration should reduce displacement under 20 N without increasing opposite-corner lift. If both configurations improve equally, ordinary clamp friction remains sufficient explanation. Failure under the right-contact card defeats disturbance tolerance.
openings.probe: Measure rim access, strip and bolt reach, edge engagement, independent adjustment and removal clearance before fabrication. If feasible, use twelve closure/pull trials: rival once ordinary and once disturbed, then candidate ten opening cycles with cycle ten disturbed. Hold closure setting and pull direction constant. Record closed marked position, loaded displacement, lift, reopening seconds and new seal tears. Keep fabrication within ninety minutes and observation within twenty; the rival contrast does not establish its durability.
assumptions: Rim geometry, bolt lengths and independent registration adjustment are unknown; failure of any requires no fabrication branch.
Padded contact must avoid permanent deformation and new seal tears; retain existing hatch, rim and seal, use no powered mechanism and keep loose pieces recoverable.

Defeat: position exceeds 1 mm after ten cycles, inability to withstand 20 N, reopening exceeds 30 seconds, obstructed opening, damage or resource/time shortage. Disturbed closure retains every requirement except seal-contact continuity; performance is unproven.

attacks.dependency: Accessible rim and sufficient strip/bolt reach.
Shared closure pressure provides retention without corner lift.

assessment: One uncertain prototype opening; geometry screening and a rival contrast may support investigation, not deployment or established feasibility.

lineage.reason: Make registration independent of pressure and explicitly test attachment and adjustment dependencies.
